alt: A sculpture of a palm tree crafted entirely from various types of yellow and white pasta stands on a black tray against a red and purple background.
Two chefs stand behind an elaborate food sculpture made of yellow ingredients, featuring a rooster perched on a bamboo fence above a hen in a nest.

A yellow sculpture resembling a sunflower with a stem made of small beads and a base of lace-like material, featuring the word "LIBERTY" on a small sign at its base, set against a vibrant red background.
A smiling woman with long dark hair stands next to a life-sized statue of Cleopatra wearing an elaborate golden headdress and black dress with gold embellishments.
